opening.speaker: rider
opening.text: The black hood leans down towards you, and a breath like cold water on a grave drags at your lungs. 'Shhhire... Bagggins...'

baggins_default.speaker: rider
baggins_default.text: 'Where... is... Baggins? Where... is... the Shire-folk? Speak!'

baggins_default.speaker: player
baggins_default.text: (You shake your head. Your tongue will not move.)

baggins_default.speaker: rider
baggins_default.text: 'You smell of the road. You have seen him. Tell me... where is the Ring?'

baggins_hobbit.speaker: rider
baggins_hobbit.text: 'Shire-folk! Small one... you reek of the Shire. You are of his kind. Where is Baggins?'

baggins_hobbit.speaker: player
baggins_hobbit.text: (You try to cry out, but your breath is stolen from you.)

baggins_hobbit.speaker: rider
baggins_hobbit.text: 'Baggins! Baggins! The Ring was in the Shire. Your master's thief has fled. Tell me his road, little thing, and live!'

baggins_hobbit.speaker: player
baggins_hobbit.text: (Cold iron fear locks your knees; the hood bends closer still.)

closing.speaker: narrator
closing.text: The dark shape swells and the world goes out like a snuffed candle. You fall.
